name: Coinbase-Binance price premium WMA(8) zero-cross
author: Pine community script
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe unless stated in the rules; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe.
indicators: Coinbase and Binance close, WMA(8), WMA(22), SuperSmoother
entry_long: premium = Coinbase close - Binance close; WMA(8) of premium (or SuperSmoother, raw premium, or WMA8 vs WMA22 cross depending on mode) crosses above 0 -> long.
entry_short: Optional short on cross under 0 when onlyLong=false.
exit: Close long when the same series crosses below 0 (long-only default).
filters: Date range filter from script start date; time restriction input
implementation_notes: Modes selected by booleans (smooth/diff/ma strategy); default mode: WMA(8)(premium) zero-cross.
